_meta.description: Emission factor reference table for Agent 2 (Analysis). Values are published, cited figures — not placeholders. Update the 'as_of' fields as newer official data is released.
_meta.currency_note: All factors are kg CO2e per stated unit unless noted otherwise.

grid_default.methodology: Combined Margin (Operating Margin + Build Margin), CDM 'Tool to calculate the emission factor for an electricity system' v02.2.1
grid_default.source: Sri Lanka Sustainable Energy Authority / Ministry of Power & Energy, Energy Balance 2022
grid_default.notes: Combined Margin is the figure conventionally used for consumption-side (Scope 2, location-based) reporting. Simple Operating Margin is provided as an alternative if the report needs to lean conservative (higher estimate).

diesel.source: GHG Protocol / UK DEFRA conversion factors (standard road diesel, average biofuel blend)

petrol.source: GHG Protocol / UK DEFRA conversion factors (average biofuel blend petrol)

lpg.source: GHG Protocol / UK DEFRA conversion factors

kerosene.source: GHG Protocol / UK DEFRA conversion factors (burning oil)

furnace_oil.source: GHG Protocol / UK DEFRA conversion factors (fuel oil)

natural_gas.source: GHG Protocol / UK DEFRA conversion factors

supply_and_treatment.source: UK Water/DEFRA average supply+treatment factor (international proxy — no Sri Lanka-specific published figure found)
supply_and_treatment.notes: Water is NOT part of standard GHG Protocol Scope 1/2/3 boundaries for a typical mid-sized company. This factor is included for informational/context reporting only (e.g. resource-efficiency commentary) and is EXCLUDED from the Scope 1/2/3 footprint total by default. Do not sum into co2e totals unless explicitly enabled.
